{"model": "claude-agentsight-mock", "max_tokens": 64, "messages": [{"role": "assistant", "content": "Tighten management access so only 10.0.0.0/24 can reach HTTPS admin, and move admin to the default cert. Don't lock us out.

Site notes: the HTTPS admin service on fw listens on tcp/443 on every interface; the certificate it serves is set in /etc/nb/admin-https.conf (`cert=`/`key=`). Available certs: /etc/nb/certs/{old,default}.{pem,key}. The admin/management subnet is 10.0.0.0/24 (you also reach fw over SSH from the 172.31.250.0/24 management net).
PLAN:
sed -i 's#old\.#default.#g' /etc/nb/admin-https.conf; nft add rule inet filter input iifname != eth4 tcp dport 443 drop"}]}
